facts.fact: The headmistress, Miss Jagerson, is led around the school by her pet corgi.
facts.anchor: The Head’s pet corgi followed her on little scampering feet
‘Faust,’ Miss Jagerson said. ‘Do you like dogs?’

facts.fact: Senior girls sleep on the third and fourth floors, juniors are housed separately from them.
facts.anchor: The senior dormitories are a bit further along, on the third and fourth floors

facts.fact: A donor-funded worm observatory exists and is currently used only for storage.
facts.anchor: the staircase going down to the worm observatory

facts.fact: Charlotte Pontonby, a former pupil, once researched post-mortem corpse decomposition.
facts.anchor: dear Charlotte Pontonby a few years ago, who was doing a study of post-mortem corpse decomposition

facts.fact: Mrs Vaughan is the teacher students must consult before entering the laboratories.
facts.anchor: do check with Mrs Vaughan if you’re ever going in there

facts.fact: The school library holds restricted material, and only rare books are restricted, not topics.
facts.anchor: Some of the contents are under lock and key, but teachers can request access

facts.fact: The headmistress introduces the mathematics teacher Miss Jane Worth to the candidate Philomela Fen.
facts.anchor: Miss Jane Worth – Miss Philomela Fen. I trust you’ll be the best of friends.

facts.fact: Jane Worth secretly warns the candidate to leave the school immediately.
facts.anchor: Get out of here while you can!

facts.fact: The headmistress hands the candidate a battered 1970 first edition of the Cambridge Latin Course, volume three.
facts.anchor: the third volume of the Cambridge Latin Course

facts.fact: A pupil named Melicent Pomphrey polishes a knife with silver polish in class.
Faith Standon asks the candidate to exempt the class from homework for a week.
facts.anchor: you want to let us off preparation for the whole of next week

facts.fact: The headmistress wants the candidate to sign a contract immediately after the interview.
facts.anchor: I’d like to get your signature on a contract before we go any further
